summary: All three round 1 findings are resolved. The redundant @ParameterizedTest is gone (file now has zero parameterized tests, zero ParameterizedTest/ValueSource imports). The bundled blank case is split into valid_empty_returns_true and valid_whitespace_only_returns_true as two independent @Test methods. All four negative cases carry the invalid_ prefix (invalid_offset_format_gmt5_returns_false, invalid_offset_format_plus_0200_returns_false, invalid_abbreviation_ut_returns_false, invalid_nonexistent_zone_returns_false), so a --tests '*invalid*' filter now matches them uniformly. Bonus quality improvement: ValidTimezoneValidator.java lines 14-15 add an inline comment explaining the deliberate .isBlank() vs ValidPasswordValidator's .isEmpty() divergence — this turns an undocumented inconsistency into a justified one. Nine standalone @Test methods, all green, all pass the litmus test (deleting the ZoneId.getAvailableZoneIds().contains(tz) line or the null/blank short-circuit causes the corresponding tests to fail). Coverage maps 1:1 to TDD anchors in tasks/1.md. Pyramid is correct for a pure-logic validator (unit-only). No further action required.
